fact: On 29 December 2025 the CPJ2DH held a meeting on Law No. 2016-006 of 30 March 2016 on freedom of access to information and public documentation, in force with its implementing decree No. 2017-104/PR, with the Médiature named for disputes and non-response.
title: Togo l Le CPJ2DH verse au débat la Loi n° 2016-006 du 30 mars
